digest.component_or_area: Bridge git delivery (push and merge recovery)
propositions: Bridge git push abandons after a single transport failure (TLS, DNS, timeout) even when the failure is transient and retriable, leaving converged commits unpushed and lost on runner shutdown

Transport faults (certificate verification, connection reset, RPC failure, promisor fetch failure) are currently treated identically to permanent policy declines and receive zero retries, while only non-fast-forward rejections are retried up to _MAX_RETRIES

The merge recovery leg (_merge_remote_under_lock with blob:none partial clone) fails with merge-recovery-blocked on promisor on-demand fetch transport faults, when the fault should be classified as retriable and not terminal
Retries for transport faults must be bounded to 3 total attempts per leg with attempt-indexed backoff (0.5s, 2.0s) to survive transient blips without prolonging downtime on real outages
Push and merge classification, backoff, and strict-reporting logic must be extracted to a new module (push_classify.py) to stay within the 800-LOC hard cap
